lyrics.en: ※This translation is currently generated by AI. The refined version is
lyrics.zh: ※此翻譯暫時是AI生成的。人工的翻譯會容後更新！

lyrics.ja: 陽は沈んで　ネイビー空
lyrics.romaji: Hi ha Shizunde Neibii Sora
lyrics.en: The sun sets, the sky turns navy
lyrics.zh: 夕陽西沉，深藍的天空

lyrics.ja: 街はまだまだ続くけど
lyrics.romaji: Machi ha Mada Mada Tsuzuku kedo
lyrics.en: The city still goes on and on
lyrics.zh: 街道仍會不斷延續

lyrics.ja: また呼ぶ声、聞こえるのかい
lyrics.romaji: Mata Yobu Koe, Kikoeru no Kai
lyrics.en: Can you hear the voice calling again?
lyrics.zh: 又聽見了呼喚的聲音，你聽得到嗎

lyrics.ja: 小さいけどほら遠くから
lyrics.romaji: Chiisai kedo Hora Tooku kara
lyrics.en: It's small, but look, from far away
lyrics.zh: 雖然微弱，但聽啊，從遠方傳來

lyrics.ja: 滑り込みの感情なら良くも悪くも衝動的で
lyrics.romaji: Suberikomi no Kanjou Nara Yoku mo Waruku mo Shoudouteki de
lyrics.en: If it's a last-minute feeling, it's impulsive for better or worse
lyrics.zh: 若是臨時湧上的情感，無論好壞都如此衝動

lyrics.ja: 涙ながら歌えたならそれもそれで悪かないさ
lyrics.romaji: Namida Nagara Utaeta Nara Sore mo Sore de Warukunai sa
lyrics.en: If I can sing through tears, then that's not so bad either
lyrics.zh: 若能含淚歌唱，那倒也不算壞事

lyrics.ja: さぁ、声を枯らすなら
lyrics.romaji: Saa, Koe wo Karasu Nara
lyrics.en: Now, if you're going to strain your voice
lyrics.zh: 來吧，若要聲嘶力竭

lyrics.ja: 届くこともあると思うから
lyrics.romaji: Todoku Koto mo Aru to Omou kara
lyrics.en: Because I think it can sometimes reach
lyrics.zh: 因為我相信有時也能傳達到

lyrics.ja: 続けてみよう！
lyrics.romaji: Tsuzukete Miyou!
lyrics.en: Let's keep going!
lyrics.zh: 繼續嘗試吧！

lyrics.ja: 冴えない君に向けなよ
lyrics.romaji: Saenai Kimi ni Muke na yo
lyrics.en: Aim it at your dull self
lyrics.zh: 就對著那個不起眼的你吧

lyrics.ja: らぶらぶらぶらぶらぶらぶあいうぉんちゅー
lyrics.romaji: Rabu Rabu Rabu Rabu Rabu Rabu Ai Won Chuu
lyrics.en: Love love love love love love, I want you
lyrics.zh: 愛愛愛愛愛愛，I want you

lyrics.ja: 不甲斐ない頼んない自分を愛せたら
lyrics.romaji: Fugainai Tayorinai Jibun wo Aisetara
lyrics.en: If you can love your pathetic, unreliable self
lyrics.zh: 若能愛上那個沒出息又不可靠的自己

lyrics.ja: 涙が出てくるよね
lyrics.romaji: Namida ga Dete Kuru yo ne
lyrics.en: Tears will come out, won't they
lyrics.zh: 眼淚就會奪眶而出吧

lyrics.ja: それだけのことがもう
lyrics.romaji: Sore Dake no Koto ga Mou
lyrics.en: Just that alone
lyrics.zh: 明明只是這樣的事

lyrics.ja: なんでここまで難しく思えるの
lyrics.romaji: Nande Koko made Muzukashiku Omoeru no
lyrics.en: Why does it feel so difficult?
lyrics.zh: 為何會覺得如此困難呢

lyrics.ja: せめて倒れずいよう
lyrics.romaji: Semete Taorezu Iyou
lyrics.en: At least let's not fall down
lyrics.zh: 至少不要倒下吧

lyrics.ja: 陽は昇れど、鈍色空
lyrics.romaji: Hi ha Noboredo, Nibiiro Sora
lyrics.en: Though the sun rises, the sky is dull gray
lyrics.zh: 縱使太陽升起，天空仍是暗灰色

lyrics.ja: 夜は今にも終わるけど
lyrics.romaji: Yoru ha Ima ni mo Owaru kedo
lyrics.en: The night is about to end
lyrics.zh: 夜晚即將結束

lyrics.ja: あれもこれも持ち出すには
lyrics.romaji: Are mo Kore mo Mochidasu ni ha
lyrics.en: To bring out this and that
lyrics.zh: 想把這個那個全都帶上

lyrics.ja: 少し両手じゃ足りないや
lyrics.romaji: Sukoshi Ryoute ja Tarinai ya
lyrics.en: Two hands are just not quite enough
lyrics.zh: 光靠雙手似乎有點不夠啊

lyrics.ja: もう声が枯れそうだ
lyrics.romaji: Mou Koe ga Kare Sou Da
lyrics.en: My voice is already about to give out
lyrics.zh: 聲音已經快要枯竭

lyrics.ja: 誰かこれを聞いててほしいと
lyrics.romaji: Dareka Kore wo Kiitete Hoshii to
lyrics.en: I just wish someone would listen to this
lyrics.zh: 只希望有誰能聽著這一切

lyrics.ja: 願うだけだ！
lyrics.romaji: Negau Dake Da!
lyrics.en: That's all I can wish for!
lyrics.zh: 僅此心願！

lyrics.ja: 嫌いな君に向けなよ
lyrics.romaji: Kirai na Kimi ni Muke na yo
lyrics.en: Aim it at the self you hate
lyrics.zh: 就對著那個討厭的你吧

lyrics.ja: らぶらぶらぶらぶらぶらぶあいうぉんちゅー
lyrics.romaji: Rabu Rabu Rabu Rabu Rabu Rabu Ai Won Chuu
lyrics.en: Love love love love love love, I want you
lyrics.zh: 愛愛愛愛愛愛，I want you

lyrics.ja: つまんない下んない自分を見ていたら
lyrics.romaji: Tsumannai Kudannai Jibun wo Mite Itara
lyrics.en: When I look at my boring, worthless self
lyrics.zh: 看著那個無聊又沒出息的自己

lyrics.ja: ため息が出ちゃうよね
lyrics.romaji: Tameiki ga Dechau yo ne
lyrics.en: I can't help but sigh
lyrics.zh: 不禁就會嘆息吧

lyrics.ja: もがけばもがくほどに
lyrics.romaji: Mogakeba Mogaku Hodo ni
lyrics.en: The more I struggle
lyrics.zh: 越是掙扎

lyrics.ja: 疲れて泣きたくなるけど後回し
lyrics.romaji: Tsukarete Nakitaku Naru kedo Atomawashi
lyrics.en: I get tired and want to cry, but I'll put it off
lyrics.zh: 雖然疲憊得想哭，但先擱在一旁

lyrics.ja: せめて動かずいよう
lyrics.romaji: Semete Ugokazu Iyou
lyrics.en: At least let's stay still
lyrics.zh: 至少先不要動吧

lyrics.ja: 冴えない君に向けなよ
lyrics.romaji: Saenai Kimi ni Muke na yo
lyrics.en: Aim it at your dull self
lyrics.zh: 就對著那個不起眼的你吧

lyrics.ja: らぶらぶらぶらぶらぶらぶあいうぉんちゅー
lyrics.romaji: Rabu Rabu Rabu Rabu Rabu Rabu Ai Won Chuu
lyrics.en: Love love love love love love, I want you
lyrics.zh: 愛愛愛愛愛愛，I want you

lyrics.ja: 死ねない生きたいと足掻けどもがけど
lyrics.romaji: Shinenai Ikitai to Agakedo Mogakedo
lyrics.en: I can't die, I want to live—though I struggle and writhe
lyrics.zh: 死不了，想活下去，縱使不斷掙扎

lyrics.ja: 涙が出てくるよね
lyrics.romaji: Namida ga Dete Kuru yo ne
lyrics.en: Tears will come out, won't they
lyrics.zh: 眼淚還是會流出來吧

lyrics.ja: それでも何だか僕らは
lyrics.romaji: Sore demo Nandaka Bokura ha
lyrics.en: But still, somehow, we
lyrics.zh: 即使如此，不知為何我們

lyrics.ja: 諦めきれずに明日も歌うから
lyrics.romaji: Akirame Kirezu ni Ashita mo Utau kara
lyrics.en: Because we can't give up, we'll sing again tomorrow
lyrics.zh: 因為無法徹底放棄，明天也會繼續歌唱

lyrics.ja: ずっと倒れずいよう
lyrics.romaji: Zutto Taorezu Iyou
lyrics.en: Let's never fall down
lyrics.zh: 一直都不要倒下吧
